scientific_role: Restricted cross-domain transportability analysis of the frozen NRD common-variable-only model; not national claims validation.

stage0_aggregate_quarantine.rule: Previously generated coarse MIMIC counts and unplanned-status-unfiltered readmission rates may justify feasibility only. They may not select eligibility rules, models, features, calibration, thresholds, ontology, endpoints, subgroups, or reporting cutoffs.

population.age_rule: admission_age >= 18, derived as anchor_age + admission_year - anchor_year; nonfinite or implausible values outside 18-120 are excluded
population.primary_ap_rule: principal diagnosis seq_num=1, icd_version=10, normalized code starts with K85
population.alive_discharge_rule: hospital_expire_flag=0 and no in-hospital death before episode discharge
population.timestamp_rule: subject_id and hadm_id present; admittime and dischtime valid; dischtime >= admittime
population.multiple_indices: retain all nonduplicate eligible index episodes; uncertainty intervals resample subject_id so repeated episodes remain clustered
population.icd9_sensitivity: ICD-9 principal 5770 may be evaluated only as a separately labelled sensitivity analysis after the primary result is frozen; it cannot alter the primary model or conclusion

episode_construction.primary_transfer_collapse: Collapse overlapping admissions and admissions separated by <=24 hours when either the prior discharge_location denotes transfer to another acute hospital or the next admission_location denotes transfer from another hospital. Resolve chains transitively.
episode_construction.overlap_rule: Always collapse when next admittime <= current episode dischtime.
episode_construction.sensitivity_transfer_collapse: Collapse every same-day or <=24-hour gap regardless of transfer labels.
episode_construction.index_definition_after_collapse: An episode is an AP index when at least one component has principal ICD-10-CM K85; the earliest such component defines the index anchor. Features may use only information recorded by the final discharge of the collapsed episode.
episode_construction.deduplication: Within an episode, deduplicate diagnosis and procedure records by normalized code, version, sequence, and procedure date before deterministic ordering.

prediction_anchor_and_history.anchor: final discharge time of the collapsed AP index episode
prediction_anchor_and_history.history: only earlier same-system MIMIC admissions ending before the index episode begins
prediction_anchor_and_history.future_exclusion: the index episode's future admissions, all post-discharge records, and any later outcome information are prohibited from predictors
prediction_anchor_and_history.observability: history flags describe availability within MIMIC only and never imply observation outside the health system
prediction_anchor_and_history.vocabulary: frozen NRD development vocabulary; no MIMIC token may expand or reorder it
prediction_anchor_and_history.unsupported_codes: unsupported or unseen codes map to the frozen OOV representation and are counted in an immutable OOV audit

readmission_window.candidate: subsequent inpatient MIMIC episode for the same subject_id after transfer collapsing
readmission_window.noncapture_rule: absence of a recorded MIMIC readmission is interpreted only as no recorded same-system readmission; it is not evidence of no hospitalization elsewhere

planned_readmission_under_shifted_dates.problem: MIMIC dates are shifted at patient level, so the displayed calendar year cannot select the true annual CMS Planned Readmission Algorithm mapping.
planned_readmission_under_shifted_dates.procedure_scope: all procedure positions for PRA PR.1/PR.3
planned_readmission_under_shifted_dates.diagnosis_scope: principal diagnosis only for PRA PR.2/PR.4
planned_readmission_under_shifted_dates.stable_planned: all five annual rule sets classify the candidate as planned
planned_readmission_under_shifted_dates.stable_unplanned: all five annual rule sets classify the candidate as unplanned
planned_readmission_under_shifted_dates.algorithm_unknown: annual classifications disagree, a required mapping is missing, the principal diagnosis is absent or unsupported, or required procedure information is not classifiable
planned_readmission_under_shifted_dates.candidate_selection: skip stable-planned candidates. The first stable-unplanned candidate is the qualifying readmission only if no earlier algorithm_unknown candidate occurred in the 30-day window.
planned_readmission_under_shifted_dates.unknown_precedence: an algorithm_unknown candidate before the first stable-unplanned candidate, or any algorithm_unknown candidate when no stable-unplanned candidate exists, makes the index episode's primary planned-status-dependent label algorithm_unknown
planned_readmission_under_shifted_dates.primary_handling: exclude algorithm_unknown index episodes from planned-status-dependent primary performance denominators
planned_readmission_under_shifted_dates.required_bounds: report two extreme sensitivity bounds: treat every algorithm_unknown candidate as planned, and treat every algorithm_unknown candidate as unplanned
planned_readmission_under_shifted_dates.elective_proxy: admission_type-based elective exclusion is sensitivity-only and cannot replace the five-rule consensus classification

cause_hierarchy.source: principal diagnosis of the first qualifying stable-unplanned readmission
cause_hierarchy.parent_invariant: qualifying readmission equals the union of the four primary leaves
cause_hierarchy.cause_unknown: if a qualifying readmission has an absent, ICD-9-only, or otherwise unsupported principal diagnosis, retain any-readmission positivity but mark all cause-specific labels unknown and exclude them from cause-specific denominators
cause_hierarchy.all_position_multilabel: sensitivity-only and may overlap; it cannot replace the primary hierarchy

permitted_endpoints: prolonged length of stay using the frozen NRD threshold LOS > 7 days
prohibited_endpoints_and_claims: complete capture of readmissions outside the MIMIC health system

model_and_calibration.model: the frozen NRD common_variable_only Transformer selected without MIMIC data
model_and_calibration.probability_calibration: apply the calibration method and parameters frozen on 2021A; no MIMIC recalibration
model_and_calibration.conformal: apply the 2021B-only frozen conformal thresholds without MIMIC recalibration
model_and_calibration.thresholds: apply the 2021A frozen operating points; no MIMIC threshold optimization
required_pending_bindings: common_variable_only final checkpoint SHA256 and bytes
frozen diagnosis and procedure vocabulary SHA256 values

evaluation.clinical_utility: decision-curve net benefit at the NRD-locked thresholds with treat-all and treat-none references
evaluation.uncertainty: 1000 subject_id-cluster bootstrap replicates with percentile 95% confidence intervals; never resample episodes independently
conformal_metrics: error rates among retained and abstained episodes

metric_event_gates.AUROC_AUPRC_Brier_log_loss: report with confidence intervals only when both outcome classes have >=20 episodes; otherwise descriptive only
metric_event_gates.calibration_intercept_slope_and_DCA: confirmatory only with >=100 events and >=100 non-events; otherwise exploratory with explicit instability warning
metric_event_gates.subgroup_conformal_coverage: >=100 target events confirmatory, 50-99 exploratory, <50 descriptive only
metric_event_gates.rare_endpoint: do not report a model-performance estimate when a resample or estimand is undefined; report the event count and suppress inferential language

subgroups.rule: No MIMIC subgroup may be selected, merged, or dropped based on observed coverage or performance.

artifact_and_release_rules.prediction_unit: one immutable row per eligible index episode with subject_id retained only in the restricted analysis artifact
artifact_and_release_rules.manifest: record row count, field schema, source/member hashes, upstream model hashes, code hashes, created time, and patient-level prediction SHA256
artifact_and_release_rules.public_release: no row-level MIMIC data, identifiers, embeddings, or predictions; release only code, synthetic examples, and disclosure-safe aggregate results permitted by the PhysioNet agreement
artifact_and_release_rules.result_suppression: apply HCUP n<=10 suppression to any combined public table containing NRD results; use the same conservative display rule for MIMIC cells for consistency

execution_gates: all pending model and vocabulary bindings are present and hash-verified
archive and required member identities are hash-bound
formal ETL code and no-data tests pass
the implementation proves that future encounters cannot enter index-time features
the implementation proves that MIMIC cannot expand the frozen NRD vocabulary
the five-year PRA consensus and unknown-precedence rules are covered by tests
formal cohort and outcome summaries are generated once from the locked implementation
predictions and evaluation are emitted with immutable manifests
